title: Check rules 1 and 2
hints: Rule 1 is done. For rule 2, look at one store at a time and find the `after` lines that mention it.
For a store `(name, version)`, gather `m` from every `(_, m, s)` in `afters` where `s == name`.
That list must equal `[version]`: exactly one `after`, and it names the version the store writes into. Return `False` as soon as one store fails.
explain: Rule 1 fails when two stores name the same version. Rule 2 is checked one store at a time: collect the first operand of every `after` whose store is this one. That list must hold exactly one version, and it must be the version the store writes into. An empty list is a store with no `after`. Two entries is a store that two `after` lines claim. One wrong entry is an `after` that names the wrong version.
